description: This file defines interfaces for the App Gateway component within the WPEFramework. It includes structures for gateway context and several interface classes for gateway resolution, authentication, response handling, request handling, telemetry, and notifications. The interfaces facilitate communication, authorization, telemetry, and event notification for applications interacting through the gateway.

classes.name: GatewayContext
classes.description: Structure holding the request ID, connection ID, and application ID, representing the execution context of a gateway operation.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving application requests, adding resolution paths, and processing resolution requests.

classes.name: IAppGatewayAuthenticator
classes.description: Interface for authenticating sessions, retrieving session IDs, and checking permission groups.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResponder
classes.description: Interface for sending responses, emitting notifications, forwarding requests, and retrieving connection context parameters.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResponder::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for connection state changes (start/stop) for applications.

classes.name: IAppGatewayRequestHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling gateway requests based on context and method.

classes.name: IAppGatewayTelemetry
classes.description: Interface for recording telemetry events and metrics related to gateway activity.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Adds additional resolution paths to the gateway.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request based on context, origin, method, and parameters.

methods.name: GetSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID for a given application.

methods.name: CheckPermissionGroup
methods.description: Checks if an application belongs to a specific permission group.

methods.name: Respond
methods.description: Sends a response payload to a specified context.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits a notification to a specified context.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Forwards a request to the client with specified connection ID, request ID, method, and parameters.

methods.name: GetGatewayConnectionContext
methods.description: Retrieves context information like headers or URL parameters for a given connection.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers for connection state change notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters for connection state change notifications.

methods.name: HandleAppGatewayRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming application gateway requests based on context and method.

methods.name: RecordTelemetryEvent
methods.description: Records a telemetry event with associated context and data.

methods.name: RecordTelemetryMetric
methods.description: Records a telemetry metric with associated context and value.

methods.name: void OnAppConnectionChanged(const string & appId,const uint32_t connectionId,const bool connected)
